From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>; Arianna Cole <arianna@acme.com>, Samir Gupta <samir@talentlab.io>
Date: 2026-08-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Ariel Park — final scorecards and closure (24h window)

Team —

Quick note to close out Ariel Park's loop. We have all five interview writeups in GH, but only three completed scorecards in the shared drive. Arianna / Samir — thanks for coordinating the schedule; we need the final quantitative inputs to reach a decision.

Ask: please complete the scorecard attached (ArielPark_scorecard_template_v3.pdf) or paste your numeric scores into the Google Doc by 24 hours from now (deadline: 2026-08-19T09:12:00-07:00). If you have qualitative concerns, add them inline under the "tech notes" section.

Two operational clarifications:
- If we end up with a 2-2 split on hire/no-hire, Karthik will do the tiebreaker with a short follow-up interview (or proxy vote) — we should commit to that now to avoid delays.
- Mina flagged that the interviews skewed toward implementation; if you think technical depth wasn't adequately probed, mark "needs-rescore" and include a one-line rationale. We'll allow one rescoring window before the deadline.

Attachments: interview-rubric-tech-v2.xlsx (mapping of criteria -> score bands).

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-08-18T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ariel Park — final scorecards and closure (24h window)

Jonas — I agree with the closure window, but want to expand on the "technical nuance" note I mentioned earlier.

Summary of concern: the pairing session covered algorithms and a medium implementation prompt; there was no systems-design or architecture question. My score reflects that (lower on "depth") but that doesn't capture Ariel's reasoning on trade-offs — which I probed verbally. Before we finalize, I propose we: 
1) allow a rescoring flag (I will submit a scorecard marked "needs-rescore")
2) include a short bullet under "tech notes" summarizing what I'd want validated in a quick 20-min follow-up (surface-level system design + scaling considerations).

If team prefers not to rescore, I'm OK with Karthik doing the tiebreaker, but I wanted this called out so hiring has context.

—Mina
Mina Haddad
Principal SWE, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Ariel Park — final scorecards and closure (24h window)

Thanks for raising, Mina. I support the rescoring flag and think we should normalize scores across interviewers if the qualitative notes point to a missing probe. Operationally:
- We accept up to one rescoring per interviewer before deadline.
- If rescoring changes the numeric outcome and produces a tie, I will take the tiebreaker (20-min tech async or short live follow-up).

Arianna — FYI on process; if Acme needs an ETA for a hire decision, we should keep to the 24h window unless we trigger a follow-up.

Karthik

Director, Infrastructure Engineering, Redwood Inference

Thanks all — quick summary and action items (final):
1) Deadline: 2026-08-19T09:12:00-07:00 for numeric score submission or a rescoring flag.
2) Rescoring: allowed (one per interviewer). If you flag "needs-rescore", add a 1-2 line rationale under "tech notes".
3) Tiebreaker: Karthik will perform a 20-min follow-up or proxy vote if we hit a 2-2 split.
4) Marissa — confirm you and Samir have candidate availability for a short follow-up (if needed). Arianna — please let us know if Acme has timeline constraints.

Attachments and links included. I'll consolidate and publish the final decision to the Greenhouse role after the deadline.

Thanks — Jonas
